Module com.lmax.solana4j
Package com.lmax.solana4j.api

Interface MessageVisitor.Version1MessageView

  • All Superinterfaces:
    MessageVisitor.MessageView
    Enclosing interface:
    MessageVisitor<T>
    public static interface MessageVisitor.Version1MessageView
extends MessageVisitor.MessageView
    Interface representing a view of a Solana V1 message.

    V1 messages raise the size limit to 4,096 bytes, move resource limits into the message itself via a transaction config, and do not support address lookup tables.

    • Method Detail

      • version

        int version()
        Retrieves the version number of this message.
        Returns:
        the version number of the message, expected to be 1 for V1 messages

      • configMask

        int configMask()
        Returns the config mask of the V1 message.

        The config mask is a bitmask indicating which config values are present in the message. Bits 0-1 indicate priority fee, bit 2 indicates compute unit limit, bit 3 indicates loaded accounts data size limit, and bit 4 indicates requested heap size.

        Returns:
        the config mask as an int

      • instructions

        java.util.List<MessageVisitor.LegacyInstructionView> instructions()
        Retrieves the list of instructions included in this V1 message.

        V1 messages do not support address lookup tables, so their instructions reference static accounts only, exactly like legacy messages. For that reason this method reuses MessageVisitor.LegacyInstructionView rather than defining a V1-specific view.

        Returns:
        a list of MessageVisitor.LegacyInstructionView objects representing the instructions
